reason: A provides the clearer, better-grounded mechanistic test: controlled Al/trace-Y addition, formation of an adherent Al2O3 barrier, suppression of Mn outward diffusion, and directly measurable oxidation, spallation, and depletion outcomes against an unmodified baseline.
